class.name: NNBTRandomSequence
class.brief_description: Runs child branches in a random order until all succeed, or fails as soon as one fails.
class.description: Works like [NNBTSequence], but shuffles its enabled children at the start of each run so every step still completes in a varied order. Returns [constant NNBTNodes.SUCCESS] once all succeed, [constant NNBTNodes.RUNNING] while a child is running, and [constant NNBTNodes.FAILURE] if any fails.
